title: Sensor Reading Request
description: JSON Schema for the POST /api/v1/readings request body. This is a documentation-only contract; runtime validation will be performed by Pydantic in the FastAPI backend.

device_code.description: Stable, non-secret device identifier. Must match a registered, active device.

event_id.description: Device-assigned, monotonically increasing event identifier. Unique per device. Used for deduplication and idempotent retries.

measured_at.description: UTC timestamp from the device clock at the time of measurement. Nullable if the device clock is unreliable. ISO 8601 format.

temperature_c.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius. Nullable if the sensor did not produce a reading.

relative_humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity in percent (0–100). Nullable if the sensor did not produce a reading.

firmware_version.description: Firmware version string reported by the device.
